nodes.statement: loop engineering (agent-orchestration + multi-agent + self-improving agents) 在未来 12 个月内会从 mainstream 进入加速期，gap_score 有望增长到 2.0+

supporting: agent-skills mainstream: vel=1856.1, conf=1.0 — highest velocity, agent toolchain is real
llm accelerating: vel=1047.3, accel=17.8, conf=1.0 — foundation layer accelerating
opportunity card: agent-skills gap=1.7, demand=9.7 — validated demand signal
Pi (earendil-works/pi): 80K stars, 308 releases in 11 months — harness pattern validated at massive scale
Pi harness design v2: durable runs + lanes(multi-agent) + checkpoint model + crash recovery — all first-class citizens, not afterthoughts
Pi team: Mario Zechner(LibGDX) + Armin Ronacher(Flask) — world-class systems+web founders betting on harness paradigm
Pi explicitly differentiates 'harness' vs 'framework' — harness=how agents run, framework=how agents are built — distinct categories
against: agent-orchestration confidence remains low (0.4), velocity flat — NOT accelerating
agent-framework vel=190.1, conf=0.4 — moderate velocity but low confidence
coding-agents vel=190.1, conf=0.4 — exists but no acceleration
multi-agent vel=152.6, conf=1.0 but accel=0.0 — stable, not growing
agent-harness, agent-governance still not individually tracked
loop engineering specific tools (harness-sdk vel=15.3, agent-framework vel=27.3) still tiny
Pi bus factor only 2-3 people; extreme contributor concentration risk
Pi is TypeScript-only, leaving Python AI/ML ecosystem underserved

nodes.statement: PI (Parallel Infinity) 生态在未来 12 个月内会从 early adopter 阶段进入 mainstream，gap_score 有望增长到 2.0+

against: pi-ecosystem vel=0.5, conf=0.1 — virtually zero signal
pi-protocol vel=0.15, conf=0.2 — 2 pieces of evidence total, no acceleration
pi-extensions vel=0.5, conf=0.1 — 1 piece of evidence
pi vel=0.21, conf=0.1 — 1 piece of evidence
all 7 pi-specific topics (parallel-infinity, pi-network, pi-protocol, pi-token, pi-consensus, pi-blockchain, pi-ecosystem) returned zero matching repos
7 additional agent-intersection topics (pi-agent, decentralized-agent, autonomous-agent, web3-agent, crypto-agent, blockchain-agent, agent-network) also returned zero matching repos
only 2 repos in 205 had any web3/crypto relevance: ccxt/ccxt (crypto trading) and mudler/LocalAI (decentralized AI)
PI ecosystem has essentially NO GitHub open-source activity — not a developer ecosystem

nodes.prune_reason: GitHub 上 Pi 生态几乎零开源活动。即使扩展了 7 个 agent 交叉 topic，205 个 repo 中只有 2 个有微弱相关。这不是数据收集不足的问题——Pi 生态在开发者社区没有实质存在。建议重新评估 Pi 的价值锚点是否依赖 GitHub 生态。
